title: Register rooms router in FastAPI app
description:
Modify chatbot/api/app.py to register the rooms_router from chatbot/api/rooms.py on the FastAPI application instance.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/api/app.py (existing FastAPI app with router registrations — understand import and include_router conventions)
- chatbot/api/rooms.py (created by task b.7 — provides rooms_router)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/app.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open chatbot/api/app.py and locate the existing app.include_router(...) calls. Understand: the variable name used for the FastAPI instance, how routers are imported, and the include_router call pattern (prefix, tags, etc.).

2. Import rooms_router from chatbot.api.rooms.

3. Add a new `app.include_router(rooms_router)` call following the existing convention. Do not change how other routers are registered.

4. Do NOT create a new FastAPI instance, change the app variable name, add CORS middleware, or modify any other router registrations.

5. Ensure python -m py_compile chatbot/api/app.py passes.
acceptance_criteria: Existing router registrations in app.py are unchanged
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add CORS, middleware, auth, or any new configuration
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: add an import statement for rooms_router
follow existing import and registration conventions
forbidden: add any new features or endpoints directly in app.py
